comment: Registros parroquiales, 1722-1961 - Archidiocesis de Rosario, Iglesia Catolica, NUESTRA SENORA DEL ROSARIO (Rosario, Santa Fe). Filmed 1974. Some volumes carry their own index.
*** THE SHORTCUT. Covers 1882. Structure decoded below. Images NOT restricted. ***
*** Would hold LERENA entries before 1879 - i.e. Pablo Armando's OLDER SIBLINGS, and possibly his parents' own baptisms. ***
*** WOULD FIND PABLO ARMANDO'S PARENTS' MARRIAGE - which names all four grandparents. Arguably better than the baptism. ***
The register volume David was going to read page by page. The INDEX above should point straight at the folio, making that unnecessary.
*** THIS IS DAVID'S FILM. It covers exactly the years the index has now cleared. ***
*** CONTAINS LIBRO 27 - its printed cover ("BAUTISMOS 27, PARROQUIA DE NTRA. SRA. DEL ROSARIO") is at IMAGE 4. ***
*** Pablo Armando's parents' marriage would be here or in 4531039 (1853-1867). Names all four grandparents. ***
Read 13 Sep 2026 from the parish catalogue. Before the family is anywhere near Rosario.
Ends exactly where the index's third sequence begins. Note the 1825-1827 hole in the register itself.
*** THE FIRST OF THE THREE FILMS THAT COVER THE INDEX GAP. *** The "Indice de defunciones 1800-1888" runs A-F and stops for 1840-1881; these registers are the only way in.
*** THE THIRD - and the only death film this archive had listed until 13 September 2026. The other four were in the catalogue all along. ***

note: # *** AND THE CATALOGUE CONFIRMS THE HARD EDGE: there is NO defunciones film after 1875. ***
